source_data: Search Console export, web, last 3 months, saved 2026-11-06 (project files hdr-seo/gsc-export-2026-11-06)
rules: Titles from rounds 1 and 2 left unchanged; measure clicks around Dec 3-7.
No IT positioning; the computer page stays Computer Help.
No invented bench stories, stats or prices; photo slots marked with <!-- bench-note --> comments for the owner.
